steps.content: Since 06:00 on August 11th, the Tide of Ashes launched by the farlands has halted its advance, and the assassins infiltrating DisCity have ceased their attacks. With EDGE's deterrence taking effect, the city has gained a crucial respite to reorganize its defenses and attend to its citizens.
During this lull, a farland Sinner and Aurum Secretum Warrior named Selyna is transported by a Nirvana Port troop directly into the custody of the Minos Bureau of Crisis Control.
[Scene Change] MBCC Corridor
Outside the prisoner's cell, Elvira stands watch alongside the stern guards. When you rush over, she jumps with surprise, perhaps scared by "Hella" behind you or from dread of your current demeanor.

steps.speaker: Elvira
steps.content: Chief? Are you alright? Where's Hecate?

steps.speaker: Elvira
steps.content: Sh-she's inside. The sedative hasn't fully worn off yet. She just woke up.
You enter the detention room alone and lock the door behind you.
[Scene Change]

In the interrogation room, the Outland prisoner is locked in a restraint chair, her limbs bound by anti-Mania chains. A wall of specially designed, blast-proof one-way glass divides the space between you, supposedly to guard you against her resentful aggression, though you suspect its true purpose is to protect her from you.
She senses your entry, a subtle shift in the air, and lifts her head. Though blindfolded, she seems to stare directly through the obscuring glass, seeking your gaze.

steps.speaker: Selyna
steps.content: Heh... So DisCity's commander is nothing but a cowering mutt, too scared to even leave the kennel.

steps.speaker: Selyna
steps.content: I forgot.

steps.speaker: Selyna
steps.content: I threw it away.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: You can't just throw it away. I've seen Outland spies like you before. Aurum Secretum is a part of you, bonded to your Mania. Activate your power and summon it, now.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: You deceived the Apostles of Ashes with it, didn't you? Is it connected to BR-005? It can stop the Tide of Ashes and expose the Black Ring, can't it? Answer me!

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: This has to end. The Black Ring, the Tide of Ashes... your greatest victims are innocent people. Civilians. They are never part of this fight. They have no stake in the war. The elderly, children, countless people who can't even defend themselves. This is pointless. Their deaths are meaningless.

steps.speaker: Selyna
steps.content: Heheheh... that's rich. You get caught in an ash storm and suddenly it's my fault? This is the Nightfall Era. Catastrophes happen. People die. Cities fall. It's just the way the world works now. Or are you DisCity big-shots still too spoiled to get that?
Ignoring the warning, you shove the security door open and burst into the cell, grabbing the prisoner by the collar.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Whoever's pulling your strings, contact them! Your handler, Fraser, anyone—use your Mania dark web to reach them! Tell them to stop this now!

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: The Apostles, the Black Ring... Mania should never be turned into a weapon. That's a line you don't cross. Humanity can't control the fallout. If this continues, if catastrophes start spiraling out of control across the globe, none of you will be left to pick up the pieces. You'll burn with the rest of us.
A calculating smirk plays upon Selyna's lips. She disregards your questions entirely, her gaze sliding past you to fix upon the shadowy figure suspended in the air behind your back.

steps.speaker: Selyna
steps.content: Hah... I get it now. It's you. You're the shackles.

steps.speaker: Selyna
steps.content: Then why come to me? Why not go bother <color=#fb9259>Adelaide</color>? Hell, even I heard about you nearly beating him to death. What's the matter? Get your wrist slapped by the higher-ups? They lock you out of his cell? Is that why you're down here wasting your time with a nobody like me?

steps.speaker: Selyna
steps.content: ...Or did you finally finish the job? Ooh, aren't you a piece of work? Hahaha—
[Flashback]
(Show clean background without text, then injured character portrait with repeated punching sound effects)

steps.speaker: Adelaide
steps.content: Heheh... Heheheh... That's right. Let it all out, Chief... Pour out your hatred, your grief, your frustration... The more you do, the closer you come to understanding the Outlanders...

steps.speaker: Adelaide
steps.content: At last, we're the same... We finally understand each other, don't we? Heheheheh...
[End of Flashback]

That man's laughter echoes in your mind—a taunt deliberately crafted to shatter your control. The mere memory of it sends a surge of fury through you, stirring the Mania within until it threatens to spill over.
Selyna watches, a smirk playing on her lips, visibly satisfied with her provocation.

steps.speaker: Selyna
steps.content: Don't act so surprised. What citizen of DisCity doesn't have my people's blood on their hands? This entire city is built on our bones. You don't need a reason to kill us—you never have.

steps.speaker: Selyna
steps.content: And "civilian"? That's a convenient word. In a city this size, how can you possibly know who's not involved? Maybe they're not fighting today, but what about tomorrow? Every war criminal was somebody's innocent child once upon a time... hahaha—weren't they?

You glare at her, meeting a gaze of burning, pitch-black fury. The same corrosive fire instantly kindles in your own chest. It devours your reason, sears your throat, and twists around your hands like burning vines, screaming at you to lunge forward and choke the life from her—
You clench every muscle, wrestling the impulse back into its cage as your voice comes out strained.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Was this Fraser's idea? Or was it the Underground? Open your eyes. They're using you. They pump you full of hate just so you'll charge into the fire for them. Your rage isn't a weapon—it's their weapon.

steps.speaker: Selyna
steps.content: You're the ones who planted this hate!
She unleashes a furious roar, poised to tear your throat out.

steps.speaker: Selyna
steps.content: For years, DisCity expanded! You burned our villages! You slaughtered countless people! You think we'd just forget that blood debt?

steps.speaker: Selyna
steps.content: Why don't you go ask your own gun-toting bastards what excuse they used when they pulled the trigger?! Did they feel righteous? Has a single one of them ever been punished?!

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: It's just like when... Nngh!

steps.speaker: Jasmine
steps.content: I have no interest in killing people, but... you're not really human, are you? You're nothing but DisCity's blade!

Before you can form a response, a surge of contamination lances through you, piercing your mind with a painful memory. Mistaking your pained hesitation for doubt, the prisoner barks a laugh. She leans in, pressing her advantage, and unleashes a torrent of bitterness stored since the day of her capture.

steps.speaker: Selyna
steps.content: You get to live in luxury by sucking us dry, and you have the nerve to talk to me about what's right?!

steps.speaker: Selyna
steps.content: So what if we use the Black Ring? You deserve it! You deserve to burn! For years, the Black Rings that hit your city churned up Mania catastrophes that ravaged our lands! You brought this on yourselves!

steps.speaker: Selyna
steps.content: And don't you dare act innocent! You've used them too! Look at that damn <color=#fb9259>sky</color> and tell me I'm lying!
[Empty Scene] Show BR-003 background for 2 seconds, play BGM

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: As you can see, all Black Rings are connected to the source of Mania. Their fluctuations cause field changes on a global scale, which in turn trigger random catastrophes.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: This is technology that only DisCity, having endured more Black Rings than anyone, could have developed. We've been working around the clock, and we've just finished adjusting BR-003. It's now primed to unleash a catastrophe strike at a moment's notice.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: While our technology does not yet permit precise targeting of these strikes, it is a known fact that only DisCity is built to survive frequent catastrophes. This understanding alone will force them to stand down. In essence, it is <color=#fb9259>deterrence</color>.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: Make no mistake, this is an extreme measure. Using Black Rings and catastrophes as weapons crosses a line—it undermines the very foundation of civilization. As a beacon of progress, we would never initiate this ourselves.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: But after the Farland Alliance's reckless actions these past few days—after watching them use BR-005 and the Apostles of Ashes to attack civilians indiscriminately—their guilt is undeniable. Their crimes have given us all the moral capital we need to proceed.

steps.speaker: Selyna
steps.content: ...I see your game now. That troop of yours, the Black Ring tracking... it was just a smokescreen. All to hide what you were really building... your own Black Ring weapon to launch catastrophe strikes! You were just the bait!

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: And we owe much of this success to your efforts, Chief. By drawing the enemy's focus onto the battlefield, you created the perfect diversion for our plan to proceed smoothly.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: Now, let's end this war together. Make them surrender and hand over BR-005. That is how we secure the chance to bring your friend back.
Countless voices echo in your skull, intensifying your headache into agony. You stagger back, pressing your palms to your temples, but the clamor only grows louder.

You reach for "Hella," seeking an anchor, but her form shivers and warps—Mania has poisoned your perception. She recedes into a haze, while the laughter of your <color=#fb9259>enemy</color> rings out, clear and terrifyingly close.
—Enemy. Her presence is an immense weight, and now every word she speaks is a needle driven into your mind, threatening to shatter your will completely.

steps.speaker: Selyna
steps.content: Let me brighten your day even more. It was the Black Ring that guided us here, Furor's will that summoned the Apostles to destroy you all. We followed this revelation, so we know the truth—

steps.speaker: Selyna
steps.content: That thing following you around? It's not the brat you know. It's a phantom. A piece of the Black Ring itself, breathing with <color=#fb9259>Furor's will</color>. It didn't come to you because it missed you.

steps.speaker: Selyna
steps.content: Haha... you've been cursed by the Black Ring. And you DisCity dogs get what you deserve! As for that Sinner brat...

steps.speaker: Selyna
steps.content: The Black Ring spared her life because she's awakened! She sees the truth now; she knows who fights for real justice! She's with us! She only sought you out to kill you! Because you're her ticket to redemption for the sin of being born here!

steps.speaker: Selyna
steps.content: Hahaha!... Look at you! You're already a corpse! That's the curse she placed on you! The contamination will consume your life, rot you until you die! Do you hear me?! She came here to kill you!!!

steps.speaker: Option
options: You really get off on killing your own kind, don't you?!

steps.content: [Release Shackles] No interaction needed, just special effects, screen flash, and vibration.
[Scene Change] Corridor Outside the Door

The sudden blare of the Mania alarm jolts Elvira. Ominous pulses bleed from the isolation cell—a chamber designed to be utterly soundproof. Her face drains of all color. In a surge of panic, she hammers her fists against the heavy door.

steps.speaker: Elvira
steps.content: Chief? What's happening? Are you okay?

steps.speaker: Elvira
steps.content: Hecate!! Where are you?!
[Scene Change] Back to Isolation Cell

On the other side, you have the prisoner pinned, your hands locked around her throat, driving her down into the interrogation chair. The Mania-infused shackles pierce her flesh, siphoning her power in a relentless flow.

That flow is now your weapon. The power that was once a burden is now a part of you. For the first time, you are in perfect, terrible resonance with it. The prisoner's face, twisted in hatred, triggers a cascade of hallucinations—a flickering montage of other faces.
[Jelena, Jasmine, Aurum Secretum Warrior, Adelaide]

Your body moves on its own, fighting on pure instinct. You no longer know what's in control—the Black Ring, a Rancor, or some unknown part of yourself. Your grip tightens relentlessly, and the woman's choking voice begins to fracture.

steps.speaker: Selyna
steps.content: ...See? Hah... See? I told you... I knew it...

steps.speaker: Selyna
steps.content: Go on... Do it... Just like you butchered my people. You're... all the same... cough cough... heh... all the same...
Her voice gradually falters.

steps.speaker: Selyna
steps.content: Look upon this... See it all...

steps.speaker: Selyna
steps.content: Black Ring... let your gaze... fall upon them...
The contaminated shackles compel your hands to squeeze harder, until a figure lunges forward and grabs your arm, as if trying to stop you.
[Portrait]

"Hella" clings to you, her whole body trembling, as if she is trying to hold you back, but is just as afraid to touch you. In your daze, that contact becomes an anchor, and the world begins to snap back into focus.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: ...She said you... are different...

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: ...Said... you're strong... you will save everyone...

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: ...No... you are the same...
That face suddenly lifts and draws near, two pitch-black eye sockets so close they feel like they're about to swallow you whole. And you see it. She's smiling.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: You're just like them—!!!

Amid the shrill cry, "Hella" suddenly shatters. The little arms wrapped around you burst into hellfire, sprouting countless tentacles studded with weeping blood-eyes and grotesque, grinning mouths. Countless departed souls roar, threatening to tear you apart and devour you.
And in the chaos, you glimpse—
[Montage: July Black Ring incident small CG, flashing white gradient portraits of Saffar and various refugee NPCs to show Chief is experiencing Hella's past]

The shackles break free, the same color as her. They plunge into her body, then merge seamlessly. The attack is useless. She squeezes you tighter, and your mind floods with the roar of anger and hatred.
—And beneath it all, a faint, desperate sobbing, so quiet it might be a hallucination.

steps.speaker: Departed Souls
steps.content: Go to hell!!
Your voice is a ragged whisper, a futile attempt to call out to "her." You reach out, desperate to touch "her," but your efforts are meaningless. You cannot stop "her."

The tentacles constrict your throat, silencing your final gasp. A corrosive fluid drips from "her" face onto yours, searing your skin and seeping into your shattering consciousness, a venom distilled from pure hatred. Your mind floods with the voices of despair:

steps.speaker: Departed Souls
steps.content: Curse you... Curse you all!
[Sword Flash]

Several silver flashes slice through the air, and the pressure holding you down vanishes. Before your eyes, "Hella" is cut clean into pieces. Her form fractures, lifting and scattering like shreds of torn cloth. In that final moment, "she" looks straight at you, arm outstretched—and without thinking, you reach back.
But all your fingers catch is a fading shimmer, slipping through your grasp along with her last faint whimper. "Hella" shatters in your hands, gone.
[Black Screen] 2s
The door swings open. Someone steps inside, catching you just as your strength gives out. Silhouetted against the light, a familiar voice reaches you.

steps.speaker: Augustus
steps.content: It's just a contamination phantom. Isn't your interrogation room equipped with an anti-Mania device? Turn it on immediately.

steps.speaker: Augustus
steps.content: And...
She looks at the Outlands prisoner lying on the floor. The woman has already passed out.

steps.speaker: Augustus
steps.content: This is not how you use prisoners. Take her away.

steps.speaker: Elvira
steps.content: ...! Understood.

Elvira is the first to move. She rushes to the prisoner's side, helps the woman to her feet, and supports her onto a stretcher with other staff members before following them out. In the doorway, she pauses and throws a final glance your way.
Then, only you and Augustus remain. She sheathes her sword and offers you her hand. You remain seated, too dazed to respond.
Wordlessly, she drags the interrogation chair across the floor and sinks into it beside you. Looking into your eyes, she begins to speak, her voice low and measured.

steps.speaker: Augustus
steps.content: I just got back from WhiteSands. Went to the location you marked, picked up Squad 3, and saw the famous BR-005 for myself.

steps.speaker: Augustus
steps.content: The Ring and its Apostle swarm are already on the move. Faster than expected, but they left a clear trail. I've already sent a team to hunt them down. We'll know more soon.

steps.speaker: Augustus
steps.content: Now, go get checked out. You can't save her until those injuries are treated and you're back on your feet.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: ...No. I'm going now.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I know where the Black Ring is. Right in the heart of the Apostle swarm, a place that's practically impenetrable. Hella's in there. She's not the Corpseborne, but she's fusing with the Ring.

steps.speaker: Selyna
steps.content: That thing following you around? It's not the brat you know. It's a phantom. A piece of the Black Ring itself, breathing with <color=#fb9259>Furor's will</color>. It didn't come to you because it missed you.

No, that is Hella. Through that entanglement, you finally truly connected with her. All the longing and joy are hers. The hatred and suffering are also hers. Everything you understand and don't understand about her... it's all her. She is every fragment of that chaotically shattered consciousness.

Thrown into the heart of war. Forced to witness hatred and despair that festered for generations. Made to confront ugly, impossible questions that even the most powerful could not solve. That is why she broke—into so many pieces.
—Because you, too, had no answers to give, she left in despair.
—But you truly had none. Who has ever found a true answer to war?
You struggle to lift your head and look at the general standing before you.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: You said you wanted to cooperate. You wanted something in return... Fine. I'll do it. I know what you're after.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: No one in DisCity trusts you. You're using me to get a foothold in this war, to expand your influence... to seize power. You want this conflict to escalate because it makes them desperate. It makes them need you.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: But BR-003 is here. EDGE will take over, and your plan falls apart again.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: So use me. Let's take on the Black Ring together. You pick the target; I'll follow. Use me however you need.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I just want her back. I'm out of time. I can't wait any longer.

steps.speaker: Chaotic Rusted Voice
steps.content: Did you hear him did you hear that? He said it, he means it. Resolute in conviction, willing to die. That raw passion and courage, murderous rage and determination..
steps.female_content: Did you hear her did you hear that? She said it, she means it. Resolute in conviction, willing to die. That raw passion and courage, murderous rage and determination..

steps.speaker: Chaotic Rusted Voice
steps.content: Let him join us, let him fight, fight for you. He will be one of us. We want him, we want him, WE WANT HIM!
steps.female_content: Let her join us, let her fight, fight for you. She will be one of us. We want her, we want her, WE WANT HER!

steps.content: Augustus listens silently to every voice, every will thirsting for battle, and then—
Clank!
Her scabbard strikes the floor with sudden force, a sharp command for silence that shears your words short.
Silence floods the cell. Augustus stands with both hands resting on her sword, looming over you from the shadows, her voice heavy with undeniable authority.

steps.speaker: Augustus
steps.content: I picked you for a reason. I saw your potential.

steps.speaker: Augustus
steps.content: You despise war, but for someone you care about, you dragged your half-dead body onto the field and fought with your life. That kind of resolve... it's rare. I knew that raw material would forge an exceptional soldier—my kind of soldier.

steps.speaker: Augustus
steps.content: So I indulged you. I helped you. I was shaping you to fight by my side.

steps.speaker: Augustus
steps.content: But now, I've changed my mind.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: If your goal is to crush the Outlands, you need me. My power is the only weapon that can counter their Black Ring. So why turn it down now? I thought you were different from them... those cowards too scared to use you.
She listens to your words with complete indifference.

steps.speaker: Augustus
steps.content: Loyalty isn't something I lack. And I have no shortage of "weapons" at my command.

steps.speaker: Augustus
steps.content: What I want is a warrior with an unbreakable will. Someone who can stare into the abyss and still find a reason to fight.

steps.speaker: Augustus
steps.content: You may be capable <color=#fb9259>now</color>, but answer me this:
[CG]

steps.speaker: Augustus
steps.content: Suppose I grant your wish. I give you my resources and my power, take you to the front lines, and let you give everything you have to save this person you care for. And you do. You push beyond your limits. You leave nothing on the field—

steps.speaker: Augustus
steps.content: But you still fail. <color=#fb9259>And that child dies.</color> What would you do then?
[A flash of Hella being tortured appears for 0.5s]

A prolonged silence fills the room, broken only by the sound of your increasingly labored breathing. She showed you that image only a moment ago, and yet you are already desperately trying to forget it.

steps.speaker: Augustus
steps.content: Can't find your answer? Or do you simply refuse to think that far? Death is a constant on the battlefield. Loss is routine. Not only could you fail to save her, but your desperate charge could get countless others killed. You could sacrifice everything and gain absolutely nothing. That outcome is far more common than you think.

steps.speaker: Augustus
steps.content: So I want you to imagine that moment. Really see it. And then tell me: when that happens, will you surrender to your hatred and become a vengeful demon drenched in blood? Or will you let it break you, leaving us to pick up the pieces of a broken weapon?

steps.speaker: Augustus
steps.content: Think. And then answer me.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I won't let it... I won't let that happen! I will save her...
She studies your reaction, her gaze unwavering. The hand gripping your chin relaxes its hold as a slow, deliberate smile curves Augustus's lips.

steps.speaker: Augustus
steps.content: So, in the end, all you can do is run away...

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Chief!
[Return to portrait]
Hecate bursts in and catches you just as you collapse, probably sent by Elvira. Augustus takes the distraction as her cue to let go, rising to her feet and stepping back.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Don't you dare judge me! I am taking this seriously. I will—
You try to stop her, moving on instinct as you summon your shackles to block her path. But the contamination that seeps out with them drains what little strength you have left.
Augustus looks down at your struggle, her expression unreadable—whether it's contempt and pity, you cannot tell.

steps.speaker: Augustus
steps.content: I don't need mindless killers. Raw power alone is worthless to me. I want soldiers who will hold the line, who will keep fighting until their very last breath—warriors who never break, no matter how hellish it gets.

steps.speaker: Augustus
steps.content: But that's not you. The reason you fight is far too frail.

steps.speaker: Augustus
steps.content: Stay back. This war is no place for you.
The door swings close.
[Scene Change]
Without another word, she strides out of the interrogation room. Her deputy is waiting outside, and they depart together under the gazes of nervous onlookers.
Not until they reach a nearly empty stretch of hallway does the deputy finally speak.

steps.speaker: Iron-Masked Man
steps.content: ...Are you sure about this?

steps.speaker: Augustus
steps.content: About what? Think I said too much?

steps.speaker: Iron-Masked Man
steps.content: No, I mean...

steps.speaker: Iron-Masked Man
steps.content: You clearly hold him in high regard. And he's essential for the coming battle, isn't he?
steps.female_content: You clearly hold her in high regard. And she's essential for the coming battle, isn't she?

steps.speaker: Chaotic Rusted Voice
steps.content: Why did you stop... General? We live for slaughter, we die for victory, yet now we lie silent in pools of blood...

steps.speaker: Chaotic Rusted Voice
steps.content: We do not understand... The enemies still live, the Rancors still thirst for blood. He's one of us. Why not recruit him?
steps.female_content: We do not understand... The enemies still live, the Rancors still thirst for blood. She's one of us. Why not recruit her?

steps.speaker: Augustus
steps.content: ...Yeah. With him, our job would be much easier. We'd probably get to rescue the person he's after, too.
steps.female_content: ...Yeah. With her, our job would be much easier. We'd probably get to rescue the person she's after, too.

steps.speaker: Augustus
steps.content: But the sharper the blade, the easier it shatters. The moment his resolve breaks... the war will consume him.
steps.female_content: But the sharper the blade, the easier it shatters. The moment her resolve breaks... the war will consume her.

steps.speaker: Augustus
steps.content: I won't watch another good blade shatter. Not again. Not after what happened to all of you...

steps.speaker: Augustus
steps.content: He doesn't belong in a war. This old debt... it's ours to settle.
steps.female_content: She doesn't belong in a war. This old debt... it's ours to settle.

steps.content: As she says this, she lifts her head.
At the end of the corridor, a pitch-black triangle slowly emerges from the shadows and hovers before Augustus.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: The EDGE meeting has just concluded. The consensus is to keep BR-005 operational. Let the Outlanders continue to believe they still have a chance. It keeps their attention right where we want it.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: That Black Ring is still in its infancy. With ${PlayerName} and that Sinner... our contingencies are more than sufficient. It's not a threat.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: Which is precisely why EDGE wants you to use this situation. Deploy covertly, push into the farlands, and eliminate the opposition directly.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: In return, you have my word, General Augustus: win this battle, and your exiled forces will be fully "exonerated." And, if you want it, the position of Commander-in-Chief is yours.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: After Dravyn's death, you led your forces away from DisCity because the title of "Commander" went to someone else, didn't it? That was twelve years ago. Come back now. This time, the position is undisputedly yours.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: The methods are yours to choose. Succeed in this mission, and I guarantee everything you and your forces lost will be restored.
Unlike the one that accompanies ${PlayerName}, this triangle has a small number engraved in a hidden spot.

steps.speaker: Augustus
steps.content: ...A bait perfectly crafted for me. You've certainly done your research.

steps.speaker: Augustus
steps.content: You promise me power. But in whose name do you make that promise? EDGE-05? The Cavendish family? Or <color=#fb9259>the Sillage Society</color> behind you?
A burst of electrical static sweeps through the air, resembling a quiet chuckle.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: In the name of <color=#fb9259>Bernadette</color>, and everything it stands for.
[Scene Change] WhiteSands Enemy Camp

steps.speaker: Farland Advisor B
steps.content: ...We've received a message from the Mania dark web. The Senate is on edge. They're demanding to speak with you.

steps.speaker: Farland Advisor B
steps.content: Lieutenant Colonel... do you...

steps.speaker: Fraser Officer
steps.content: ...Hang up. They're not afraid of the catastrophe, they're just afraid it'll land on their doorstep. I don't have time to waste on cowards.

steps.speaker: Fraser Officer
steps.content: If DisCity has deployed that weapon and we flinch now, that will be true defeat.

steps.speaker: Fraser Officer
steps.content: Send our order through the Mania web: all Aurum Secretum Warriors who have infiltrated DisCity are to cease attacks and go to ground. I'll quickly reformulate our approach.

steps.speaker: Fraser Officer
steps.content: The war isn't over. In fact, we've never been closer to victory. Press on! We can't let Adelaide's sacrifice be for nothing.

steps.speaker: Fraser Officer
steps.content: We're past the point of no return. The world must change.
